flags_for_codex_final_crosscheck: electrolytes.md §4 consensus bullet ('0.45% saline 無適應症') and electrolytes-completion-to-codex.json ('0.45% not indicated') remain categorical, conflicting with fluid-insulin rev 2 wording (not established, not definitively excluded). Not changed: outside editorial scope (clinical meaning). Summary follows fluid-insulin rev 2 and notes this in §9.

Specialist reports keep their own reference numbering ([1]-[14], inline citations); only the summary uses register S-IDs. Mapping: electrolytes [1]=S01, [1b]=S02, [2]=S19, [3]=S03, [4]=S09, [6]=S10, [7]=S11, [11]=S15.

Access-status differences are reader-specific, not contradictions: S01 Diabetes Care HTML read by specialists vs metadata-only for librarian; S19 2009 consensus full text read by electrolyte-specialist vs metadata-only for librarian.
Electrolytes §0.1 / D3 Fig 4 values remain peer-visual only; ADA 2026 Fig 16.1 unread by all.
Both specialist reports changed on disk between my first read and my edits; I re-read and applied string-matched edits against the current versions. Recommend Codex diff-check both before release.

original.quote_budget: Only one verbatim English sentence retained from a source: S02 2024 consensus 'no current studies on transitioning to ultra-long-acting insulin' (~14 words, fluid-insulin.md §5.1). Remaining quoted strings are section-heading locators, alt-text label (3 words), or author shorthand. All label (S16/S17/S18, NovoLog), ADA 2026 and 2009 quotes paraphrased. Locators, identifiers, numbers and access limitations unchanged.
summary_coverage: QA1-QA5 answered; case facts vs inference labelled (事實/推論); unknown MAR != not given
P unit unconfirmed (mg/dL vs mmol/L both shown); ionized Ca required

Na: same-time chem 122 vs gas 131; direct vs indirect ISE unconfirmed; TG measured Day1 not Day0; corrected Na = Na + factor*(glucose-100)/100; gas Na 131 conditional 1.6 -> 135.98, 2.4 -> 138.46; effective osm 284.83; measured osm 318; gap 25.31 described as unexplained/non-decomposable, not validated tonicity
K nadir 3.2, latest 3.4; 2024 delay-insulin wording is admission context; monitored repletion first; no individualized orders, no fixed infusion rate

Resolution: ketone <0.6 AND (pH >=7.3 OR HCO3 >=18); glucose ideally <200 not sole criterion; current BOHB missing -> indeterminate; glucose <250 add dextrose and continue insulin conditional on K safety
Fluids: no mortality/hard-endpoint benefit claimed for balanced; SCOPE-DKA cited qualitatively only (no numbers); 0.45% not established by current data but not definitively excluded
Overlap 2024 1-2 h vs ADA 2026 2 h / 2-4 h; Toujeo U300 slow onset (US PI ~6 h, steady state >=5 d; EU 3-4 d); no verified U300-specific transition trial
Priority missing data list; 5 references aligned to register IDs S02/S01, S03, S04, S09, S11 (+ labels S16-S18)
